name: SendGrid
subtitle: Email API and marketing platform
creator: Isaac Saldana, Jose Lopez and Tim Jenkins
description: One of the largest email delivery platforms, handling transactional and marketing email. It offers an API and SMTP relay, templates, analytics and dedicated IPs on higher plans.

languages.youWrite: SDKs for all major languages, or SMTP

concepts.explanation: Send via HTTP or classic mail protocol.

codeSamples.label: Python
codeSamples.code:
import os from sendgrid import SendGridAPIClient from sendgrid.helpers.mail import Mail message = Mail( from_email="hello@acme.com", to_emails="ada@example.com", subject="Your receipt", html_content="

Thanks for your order.

", ) SendGridAPIClient(os.environ["SENDGRID_API_KEY"]).send(message)

pros: Marketing and transactional in one place

pricing.summary: No permanent free plan since 2025 (60-day trial). Email API Essentials from $19.95/mo; Pro from $89.95/mo.
